sourceParagraphs: A long report is ready for review. The decision-maker has limited reading time.
“We can summarise the finding and required decision at the beginning,” one person explains. The reader can identify the main point quickly.
A small change can make a useful difference. It helps to say what will happen next and check that others understand.
